entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer supporting multi-level states for Users, Sessions, and Agents. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval and is available as an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes a custom vector graph engine and hybrid RAG search. It provides automated fact extraction and user profile maintenance with sub-300ms recall and connectors for services like Google Drive and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that uses the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing. It employs a tiered L0/L1/L2 loading architecture and provides observable retrieval with directory-browsing trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for Hermes Agents extracts entity relationships into a knowledge graph without LLM calls. It supports local deployment using PGLite and generates cited prose answers while identifying missing information gaps.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system facilitates long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents and offers both Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This memory library serves as the upstream library for the honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper. It provides a FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs and supports hybrid search and prompt-ready context injection.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages context trees using git-like version control via brv vc commit, branch, and merge. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency memory system uses a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and provides a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage persistent memory and structured facts. It includes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive context harness provides CLI tools for solving, simulating, and investigating tasks. It supports Python and TypeScript environments and generates filesystem-based traces, reports, and knowledge artifacts.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This lossless context management plugin uses a SQLite-backed message store and a hierarchical DAG to build depth-aware summary nodes. It provides agent tools for searching and expanding compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for the Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer provides portable identity, memory, and secrets for agents including Claude Code and Hermes Agent. It features source-backed recall and repairable memory, achieving a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store data as plain-text. It supports Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code while providing local-first, zero-cost search for multi-agent systems.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It integrates via MCP, plugins, and Claude Code hooks using a hybrid retrieval method of BM25 and vector search.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based, long-term memory architecture uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered via a five-package plugin family including an MCP server and a Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This embedded plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every retrieval. It includes contradiction tracking, recency ranking, and a self-directing loop for knowledge gaps.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server utilizing SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval via SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia, URLs, and codebases, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory solution stores information as inspectable Markdown files to allow users to use an Obsidian vault as a source of truth. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to reduce prompt tokens by 94%. It renders context to assistant-specific files and supports stdio and SSE MCP servers.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces tool-schema overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through keyword selection and local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard to track estimated savings in prompt tokens.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to store memories. It features importance-weighted recall via a 1-10 ranking system and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory system that supports real, immediate event deletion. It includes an on-demand summarizer and maintains a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session AI memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage state updates and searches.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables APIs to charge for themselves using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to facilitate automated payments for AI agents.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It offers tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest by default. It supports dense HNSW ANN, sparse and exact-text recall, and MinHash deduplication through embedded or HTTP daemon execution modes.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides five native tools for managing and searching local artifacts. It includes a proactive router skill and supports an opt-in process for automatic tool-OKF generation.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It employs a hybrid search method combining BM25, vector, and graph techniques, and features automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories through semantic and literal code search. It supports grounded Q&A that includes file-and-line citations while running locally over localhost.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a library of composable skills and a software development methodology. It utilizes subagent-driven-development and a dedicated brainstorming and design refinement phase for task execution.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first prototyping system that supports HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports. It includes automation and plugin features with CLI support for coding agents, including Hermes Agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This AI memory platform enables persistent long-term memory across sessions via a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It offers client support for Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A collection of 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 domains. These skills are compatible with over 26 AI platforms and map to six industry frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool generates editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions and Mermaid text. It features 11 diagram type presets along with self-check and auto-fix capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI patterns using a two-pass detection process and a 112-entry word replacement table. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Cursor.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: An agentic evolver that automates skill deduplication, quality improvement, and evolution. It unifies skills across devices and integrates with Hermes, OpenClaw, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library providing spec-conformant Agent Plugins for Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents. It includes 12 metaskills designed to preserve state within a docs/ folder.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals. It incorporates a master router, connector skills, and supports ERC-7710 delegated permissions and x402 payments.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: A set of 822 professional agent skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. The library includes ready-to-paste exports for use with Gemini, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Codex.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation via dedicated slash commands.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: Powered by TranscriptAPI, this project provides skills for accessing YouTube transcripts, searches, channels, and playlists. It is compatible with the Agent Skills format for use in Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and other coding assistants.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It provides pre-built analytical lenses for various domains and reports findings alongside an analysis of blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library provides type-safe support for agentskills.io using Pydantic AI. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs source file edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running AI agents through a three-level work model. It utilizes file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This project provides integration for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds following the Agent Skills specification. It includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This repository provides Hermes Agent skills in SKILL.md format and installation guides in Portuguese. It supports the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project offers prompting guides for FLUX.2 and FLUX.1 models along with API integration documentation. It includes a suite of six specialized FLUX 3 video skills.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files from repositories or documentation URLs. It provides provenance through documentation URLs or file:line citations.

entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running tasks with real-time tracking of decisions and progress. It includes built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika serves as a workflow language for AI that provides static auditing via nika check. It supports local-first execution with any LLM and generates hash-chained, tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This project implements a progressive MCP client using a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It utilizes a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and provides incremental discovery of tool schemas and server metadata.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye provides a 5-layer intelligent skill retrieval system using hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion. This mechanism reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls and features graceful degradation for missing dependencies.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to specific model families and tracks quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database.

entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill uses a three-agent swarm to target hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness in code. It features a risk-tiered triage system and language-specific detection for concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.

entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with Hermes Agent and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This tool generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It produces structured reports containing core conclusions and action suggestions while utilizing semantic memory to integrate user interests.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides diverse capabilities including video-to-text for local or Douyin links and OCR for PDFs and scans. It is compatible with the agentskills.io open standard and includes features for AI text de-humanization and e-commerce material creation.

entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration. It supports hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via REST, CLI, and MCP.

entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend. It supports various frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API.

entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.

entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework allows for the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration. It supports over 23 LLM providers and provides visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control system features a Kanban board and review queues to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis. It is designed for fully-local execution on consumer GPUs using Hermes and Ollama without cloud dependencies.

It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and uses local configuration files to establish config-aware baselines.

entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents and web dashboards. It features an approval inbox for requests involving side effects.
